scenario: Elaborate and capture supported 8/10/12-bit profiles
stimulus: Build each supported width and check one sample at 0, all ones and a walking-bit pattern.
interaction: The selected width, sample edge and qualifier polarities determine which frame-qualified sensor samples enter the selected path.

scenario: Exercise rising/falling PCLK edge and both VSYNC/HREF active levels
stimulus: For each profile, toggle bus data around selected/unselected edges and drive both active and inactive qualifiers.
interaction: The selected width, sample edge and qualifier polarities determine which frame-qualified sensor samples enter the selected path.

scenario: Check VSYNC frame qualification and HREF level qualification in both PCLK modes
stimulus: Drive multi-cycle VSYNC, inactive/active HREF and legal continuous/gated clock behavior; verify no sample without a selected PCLK edge.
interaction: The selected width, sample edge and qualifier polarities determine which frame-qualified sensor samples enter the selected path.

scenario: Capture each selected PCLK edge qualified by capture, frame and HREF
stimulus: Start capture; send a deterministic pixel stream on selected PCLK edges with inactive and invalid gaps.
interaction: A qualified continuous-PCLK sample crosses the AFIFO, raises a watermark request, and is returned once and in order by APB FIFO_DATA reads.

scenario: Preserve continuous-mode sample ordering through the AFIFO
stimulus: Send a monotonically tagged sequence and read it through the public FIFO_DATA endpoint after CDC settling.
interaction: A qualified continuous-PCLK sample crosses the AFIFO, raises a watermark request, and is returned once and in order by APB FIFO_DATA reads.

scenario: Zero-extend each sample into the low bits of the 32-bit read word
stimulus: Read width-specific minimum, maximum and walking-bit values; check all unused upper bits are zero.
interaction: A qualified continuous-PCLK sample crosses the AFIFO, raises a watermark request, and is returned once and in order by APB FIFO_DATA reads.

scenario: Return one queued sample and pop exactly once on a completed APB read
stimulus: Read a known queue through APB; count successful completions and returned samples independently.
interaction: A qualified continuous-PCLK sample crosses the AFIFO, raises a watermark request, and is returned once and in order by APB FIFO_DATA reads.

scenario: Reach watermark, acknowledge the request, drain below threshold and re-arm
stimulus: Check watermark 0, 1 and FIFO depth; ACK is one APB-clock pulse; APB reads alone pop payload.
interaction: A qualified continuous-PCLK sample crosses the AFIFO, raises a watermark request, and is returned once and in order by APB FIFO_DATA reads.

scenario: Detect both transitions of the synchronized valid toggle and enqueue each eligible sample once
stimulus: Hold PCLK stopped during VSYNC; emit isolated pixel clock bursts on both selected-edge polarities; allow at least four APB cycles per pixel.
interaction: A multi-cycle APB-synchronized VSYNC arms frame state before stopped/gated PCLK pixel events cross by toggle and enter the APB SFIFO without loss or reordering.
configuration: PCLK_MODE=1; VSYNC pulse >=4 APB cycles; >=4 APB cycles/pixel

interaction: A multi-cycle APB-synchronized VSYNC arms frame state before stopped/gated PCLK pixel events cross by toggle and enter the APB SFIFO without loss or reordering.

scenario: Verify the gated-mode minimum pixel interval includes the stated integration timing margin
stimulus: Apply legal pixel spacing of at least four APB periods plus an explicit digital setup/hold margin; flag analog margin for STA review.
interaction: A multi-cycle APB-synchronized VSYNC arms frame state before stopped/gated PCLK pixel events cross by toggle and enter the APB SFIFO without loss or reordering.

scenario: Exercise the profile-selected PCLK edge under gated-valid-pixel operation
stimulus: Keep HREF high across gaps with no PCLK edges; check only actual selected edges create samples.
interaction: A multi-cycle APB-synchronized VSYNC arms frame state before stopped/gated PCLK pixel events cross by toggle and enter the APB SFIFO without loss or reordering.

scenario: Preserve accepted gated-mode samples in SFIFO order

interaction: A multi-cycle APB-synchronized VSYNC arms frame state before stopped/gated PCLK pixel events cross by toggle and enter the APB SFIFO without loss or reordering.

scenario: Zero-extend gated-mode samples into APB words

interaction: A multi-cycle APB-synchronized VSYNC arms frame state before stopped/gated PCLK pixel events cross by toggle and enter the APB SFIFO without loss or reordering.

scenario: Read one gated-mode sample per successful APB completion

interaction: The same passive APB4 checker observes CSR and FIFO_DATA traffic, including wait-state stability, read strobes, returned data and terminal error signaling.

scenario: Check APB setup/access sequencing and read data at completion

interaction: The same passive APB4 checker observes CSR and FIFO_DATA traffic, including wait-state stability, read strobes, returned data and terminal error signaling.

scenario: Check PSLVERR only in the final completing APB cycle

interaction: The same passive APB4 checker observes CSR and FIFO_DATA traffic, including wait-state stability, read strobes, returned data and terminal error signaling.

scenario: Wait while empty and pop once when data arrives before expiry
stimulus: Hold APB read in Access, inject one sample before threshold, and verify PREADY completion plus exactly one pop.
interaction: The empty-read timer controls APB completion while the sample-arrival race determines whether the read succeeds and pops or errors without a pop.
notes: fault=hold FIFO empty through timeout and vary sample arrival before/on/after terminal decision; expected_response=timeout 0 errors on first Access cycle, timeout N errors on the Nth empty cycle, terminal-available data succeeds and pops once, timeout error never pops.

scenario: Check zero, positive and terminal-cycle timeout semantics
stimulus: Test timeout 0, 1 and 3; inject data before, on and after the terminal decision; compare exact APB-cycle count and no-pop-on-error.
interaction: The empty-read timer controls APB completion while the sample-arrival race determines whether the read succeeds and pops or errors without a pop.
notes: fault=hold FIFO empty through timeout and vary sample arrival before/on/after terminal decision; expected_response=timeout 0 errors on first Access cycle, timeout N errors on the Nth empty cycle, terminal-available data succeeds and pops once, timeout error never pops.

scenario: Return final-cycle PSLVERR when FIFO remains empty to timeout
stimulus: Check PREADY/PSLVERR only on specified terminal cycle and verify FIFO level is unchanged.
interaction: The empty-read timer controls APB completion while the sample-arrival race determines whether the read succeeds and pops or errors without a pop.
notes: fault=hold FIFO empty through timeout and vary sample arrival before/on/after terminal decision; expected_response=timeout 0 errors on first Access cycle, timeout N errors on the Nth empty cycle, terminal-available data succeeds and pops once, timeout error never pops.

scenario: Check FIFO_DATA aligned read, write rejection, misalignment rejection and parameter bounds
stimulus: Exercise base address, misaligned offsets inside the endpoint word, write, and aligned unmapped accesses.
interaction: Endpoint address and direction errors must return APB error without changing FIFO contents or consuming a sample.
notes: fault=write FIFO_DATA and issue a misaligned endpoint access, then issue an aligned unmapped access; expected_response=write/misaligned accesses return PSLVERR without changing FIFO, while aligned unmapped accesses follow the HDS benign OKAY/zero policy.

scenario: Reject writes to the read-only FIFO_DATA endpoint
stimulus: Write the FIFO_DATA address and verify final-cycle PSLVERR, no pop and no FIFO mutation.
interaction: Endpoint address and direction errors must return APB error without changing FIFO contents or consuming a sample.
notes: fault=write FIFO_DATA and issue a misaligned endpoint access, then issue an aligned unmapped access; expected_response=write/misaligned accesses return PSLVERR without changing FIFO, while aligned unmapped accesses follow the HDS benign OKAY/zero policy.

scenario: Reject misaligned endpoint access and keep unmapped aligned access benign
stimulus: Check misaligned endpoint PSLVERR; aligned unmapped read returns zero/OKAY and write is ignored/OKAY.
interaction: Endpoint address and direction errors must return APB error without changing FIFO contents or consuming a sample.
notes: fault=write FIFO_DATA and issue a misaligned endpoint access, then issue an aligned unmapped access; expected_response=write/misaligned accesses return PSLVERR without changing FIFO, while aligned unmapped accesses follow the HDS benign OKAY/zero policy.

scenario: Check zero disable, threshold crossing, ACK hold/deassert and below-threshold re-arm
stimulus: Run watermark 0, 1, depth and depth+1; test both FIFO modes and account for documented AFIFO occupancy CDC lag.
interaction: Selected-FIFO occupancy, watermark and ACK share request state while APB reads consume payload independently; this exposes stale threshold/re-arm behavior or accidental payload consumption on ACK.

scenario: Fill FIFO, reject newest, drain old data in order and exercise simultaneous W1C/new event
stimulus: Use depth 2 to hit full deterministically in each mode; compare read queue, sticky status and clear/event race.
interaction: A full FIFO rejects the newest sample while retaining unread data, and W1C clear races are set-dominant in both storage modes.
notes: fault=fill selected FIFO then present one extra legal pixel while clearing OVERFLOW; expected_response=drop newest, preserve all older unread entries, and keep OVERFLOW set (set-dominant W1C).

scenario: Detect full rejection without overwrite or loss of old entries
stimulus: Send one additional valid sample after full; verify sticky overflow and exact preserved queue through APB reads.
interaction: A full FIFO rejects the newest sample while retaining unread data, and W1C clear races are set-dominant in both storage modes.
notes: fault=fill selected FIFO then present one extra legal pixel while clearing OVERFLOW; expected_response=drop newest, preserve all older unread entries, and keep OVERFLOW set (set-dominant W1C).

scenario: Attempt rejected and accepted PCLK_MODE transitions
stimulus: Test write while capture enabled, combined enable+mode write, either FIFO nonempty, and source not quiescent; then drain/wait and verify accepted readback.
interaction: Runtime mode selection is accepted only after capture is disabled, both queues are empty and the active source path is quiescent.
notes: fault=write PCLK_MODE while capture is enabled, either FIFO is nonempty, or source path is nonquiescent; expected_response=APB write completes OKAY but mode remains unchanged; safe transition is accepted only when all HDS guards are met.

scenario: Assert reset during an empty pending FIFO_DATA read and while gated PCLK is stopped
stimulus: Check PREADY=0, PSLVERR=0, no completion/pop through reset; release reset and send legal VSYNC then first gated pixel.
interaction: Common asynchronous reset cancels an outstanding APB data read and initializes both domains without replaying stale gated-pixel events.
notes: fault=assert common reset during an outstanding FIFO_DATA read and release APB/PCLK domains with PCLK stopped or phase-shifted; expected_response=cancel pending read without APB completion/pop and block FIFO access until both sides initialize.

scenario: Check no FIFO access before both reset domains initialize
stimulus: Restart each clock in legal order after common reset; verify empty status, no stale payload and progress after initialization.
interaction: Common asynchronous reset cancels an outstanding APB data read and initializes both domains without replaying stale gated-pixel events.
notes: fault=assert common reset during an outstanding FIFO_DATA read and release APB/PCLK domains with PCLK stopped or phase-shifted; expected_response=cancel pending read without APB completion/pop and block FIFO access until both sides initialize.

scenario: Flush each selected FIFO after capture disable and source quiescence
stimulus: Test both modes; continuous PCLK runs during AFIFO flush; check request remains set through busy assert/deassert and clears afterward.
interaction: A selected FIFO reset completes through its busy handshake, blocks reads during pending flush and preserves frame/overflow status.
notes: fault=request flush while capture is enabled and attempt FIFO_DATA access while flush is pending; expected_response=invalid flush write is ignored with OKAY, pending flush prevents pop and follows empty-read timeout semantics, frame/overflow status is retained.

scenario: Ignore flush while capture is enabled and block FIFO_DATA pop while flush pending
stimulus: Check APB write returns OKAY when ignored; during a valid flush observe no FIFO_DATA completion/pop; reads follow specified timeout policy.
interaction: A selected FIFO reset completes through its busy handshake, blocks reads during pending flush and preserves frame/overflow status.
notes: fault=request flush while capture is enabled and attempt FIFO_DATA access while flush is pending; expected_response=invalid flush write is ignored with OKAY, pending flush prevents pop and follows empty-read timeout semantics, frame/overflow status is retained.

scenario: Retain frame count and sticky overflow across FIFO-only flush
stimulus: Read both status registers before and after each selected FIFO flush.
interaction: A selected FIFO reset completes through its busy handshake, blocks reads during pending flush and preserves frame/overflow status.
notes: fault=request flush while capture is enabled and attempt FIFO_DATA access while flush is pending; expected_response=invalid flush write is ignored with OKAY, pending flush prevents pop and follows empty-read timeout semantics, frame/overflow status is retained.

scenario: Count each accepted VSYNC frame start once, suppress disabled events and retain count across flush
stimulus: Drive multi-cycle active pulses and disabled-capture events in both modes; verify modulo increment transition with formal property and runtime increments.
interaction: Frame counter accounting follows accepted active VSYNC events, independent of pixel FIFO draining and retained across FIFO flush.

scenario: Read the read-only frame counter CSR and verify common-reset-only clear
stimulus: Read counter after frame events and after FIFO flush; assert common reset and verify zero.
interaction: Frame counter accounting follows accepted active VSYNC events, independent of pixel FIFO draining and retained across FIFO flush.

scenario: Elaborate legal FIFO depths and exercise full/empty boundaries
stimulus: Build depth 2, 8 and 16; check default 8; fill/drain boundaries in both modes; reject depth 1 and non-power-of-two 3.
interaction: Compile-time profile and FIFO parameters must reject unsupported values while supported depths map to both mode-specific paths.
notes: fault=elaborate unsupported width 9 and FIFO depths 1/3; expected_response=configuration/elaboration fails clearly, while supported widths and depths 2/8/16 elaborate successfully.

stimulus: Expected-fail elaborations for width 9 and invalid depths; supported 8/10/12 profiles elaborate cleanly.
interaction: Compile-time profile and FIFO parameters must reject unsupported values while supported depths map to both mode-specific paths.
notes: fault=elaborate unsupported width 9 and FIFO depths 1/3; expected_response=configuration/elaboration fails clearly, while supported widths and depths 2/8/16 elaborate successfully.

scenario: Count qualified accepted pixels at one per permitted sample edge
stimulus: Drive continuous and legal gated traffic; compare accepted sample count and occupancy, not frame-average rate.
interaction: The seeded pixel producer and APB consumer exercise capture_rate and apb_throughput through the shared FIFO; bounded burst/stall patterns expose occupancy, overflow or ordering failures without asserting an unprovided product workload.
notes: constraints=seeded legal traffic only: profile is fixed to one supported width/edge/polarity build; data is in [0, 2^DATA_W-1]; frame/HREF qualifiers and selected sample edges follow HDS; gated pixels are at least 4 APB cycles apart plus margin; APB requests are aligned and hold fields stable through waits with PSTRB=0 on reads. Sources: HDS REQ-FUNC-001..008, REQ-PERF-001 and APB4 PROTO-APB4-3.1..3.4/Appendix-A. Synthetic clock ratios are not product limits.
configuration: Synthetic clock ratios; gated spacing per HDS

interaction: Bounded control proofs check no duplicate or early pop, exact empty-timeout completion, and legal DMA/mode/flush state transitions under reviewed APB and clock assumptions.

interaction: Bounded control proofs check no duplicate or early pop, exact empty-timeout completion, and legal DMA/mode/flush state transitions under reviewed APB and clock assumptions.

interaction: Bounded control proofs check no duplicate or early pop, exact empty-timeout completion, and legal DMA/mode/flush state transitions under reviewed APB and clock assumptions.

interaction: Bounded control proofs check no duplicate or early pop, exact empty-timeout completion, and legal DMA/mode/flush state transitions under reviewed APB and clock assumptions.

scenario: A CTRL write issued while a flush is pending, at every offset around the hardware done pulse, does not keep the request bit set
stimulus: Disable capture, request flush, then write CTRL (ignored by ERR-007) after k idle cycles for k = 0..39 in both modes; poll CTRL until the request bit clears.
interaction: A software CTRL write captured while the flush request is set races with the hardware clear of the same bit; hardware must win so the request never sticks.
notes: fault=CTRL write on the cycle of the hardware done pulse; expected_response=OKAY for the write and the request bit reads 0 within the poll limit; found the stuck request (finding F-003).

scenario: Flush: no stale sample survives the reset, a request kept high after done gets another done pulse, and the FIFO is empty when the flush completes

interaction: Bounded control proofs check no duplicate or early pop, exact empty-timeout completion, and legal DMA/mode/flush state transitions under reviewed APB and clock assumptions.

stimulus: Free APB4 traffic on the generated CSR block with free hardware load inputs; k-induction proof plus covers of the collisions.
interaction: Bounded control proofs check no duplicate or early pop, exact empty-timeout completion, and legal DMA/mode/flush state transitions under reviewed APB and clock assumptions.
